name: Unlock Token

pages.text: In your backpack menu, hold the token on the cursor and select a locked storage slot.

pages.title: Spending
pages.text: Open your own backpack, move the token onto the cursor and select a locked storage slot. The native menu checks token permission and count; payment consumes tokens from the cursor. The unlock is stored on the backpack.

pages.title: Different slots
pages.text: Current configuration files allow tokens for storage slots but disable them for augment bays and extra equipped-backpack slots. Those use their own menu costs. Putting a token into an ordinary inventory slot does not install an augment.

pages.title: Normal payment
pages.text: Without a token, the native menu shows the experience unlock cost. Pay through that menu; this operation does not require a separate Augment Bay station.
